title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.38174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present EasyProver, a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service. Using an off-the-shelf frontier model with no additional training, it proves 669/672 PutnamBench problems and all six IMO 2026 formalizations and resolves 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions and all 189 VERINA tasks by proof or refutation. Because these benchmarks are close to saturation, we also introduce Aegis, which converts competitive programming problems into much harder verification tasks over real implementations. The pipeline writes safe Rust solutions, translates them into Lean with Aeneas, generates specifications, and labels each frozen statement with a kernel-checked proof or refutation. translated_title: 扩展Lean定理证明以实现真实世界代码验证
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EasyProver，一个由具有隔离上下文的递归代理、异步搜索、并行策略探测和弹性精修服务构建的Lean证明系统。使用现成的前沿模型且无需额外训练，它证明了669/672个PutnamBench问题以及全部六道IMO 2026形式化题目，并通过证明或反驳解决了597/600个NTP4VC验证条件和全部189个VERINA任务。由于这些基准测试已接近饱和，我们还引入了Aegis，它将竞赛编程问题转换为基于真实实现的难度更高的验证任务。该流水线编写安全的Rust解决方案，使用Aeneas将其翻译为Lean，生成规约，并用经过内核检查的证明或反驳来标注每个冻结的陈述。它生成了2,045个经差分验证的Rust-Lean程序对和11,533个候选规约。与手写基准测试不同，这些任务带有实现层面的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EasyProver通过递归代理、异步搜索与并行策略探测架构，无需额外训练即可在多个数学证明与代码验证基准上接近饱和，并进一步推出Aegis流水线，将竞赛编程题转化为基于真实Rust实现的高难度自动验证数据集。
en_tdlr: EasyProver, a Lean proving system built on recursive agents with isolated contexts and asynchronous parallel search, achieves near-saturation performance on math and verification benchmarks without additional training, while its Aegis pipeline converts competitive programming problems into much harder real-implementation verification tasks.
